claim_tested: Catalytic residues of a characterised LdtF/YafK hydrolase
key_finding: X-ray structure of E. coli DpaA at 2.9 A. The paper names exactly one catalytic residue, Cys143. A full-text regex for triad/histidine/His1xx returned zero sentences assigning a catalytic His. Ala scan: K83A abolishes activity; Y109A 0.7% WT; Y131A 4% WT; R108A 41%; Q86A 62%; K130A 64%.
context: E. coli K-12 DpaA/LdtF, purified protein
confidence_and_limitations: High for Cys143. The His135 proton donor assignment in UniProt comes from PROSITE ProRule PRU01373 inference and is not stated in this paper.

claim_tested: DpaA hydrolyses the Lpp-peptidoglycan amide bond
key_finding: DpaA(C143A) is inactive. States the Cys+2 rule: DpaA-like proteins carry Ala or Asn two positions after the catalytic Cys where transpeptidases carry Arg. Their DpaA-like alignment set already includes P. aeruginosa PA3756.
context: E. coli, in vivo and in vitro
confidence_and_limitations: High for E. coli DpaA. Does not test any Pseudomonas protein.

key_finding: States that some DpaA homologues might function as L,D-carboxypeptidase, consistent with MEROPS subfamily C82.A01 which also holds Csd6 of H. pylori and Pgp2 of C. jejuni, and that DpaA homologues occur in species with no Lpp.
confidence_and_limitations: High. This is the main competing assignment and cannot be excluded on sequence.

claim_tested: LdtF activity is broader than tether hydrolysis
key_finding: LdtF also shows glycine-specific carboxypeptidase activity on muropeptides with a terminal glycine and acts as an L,D-endopeptidase on products generated by L,D-transpeptidases.
context: E. coli, purified enzyme and muropeptides
confidence_and_limitations: High for E. coli. Broadens the molecular function beyond a single substrate.

claim_tested: Function of the closest characterised ortholog of PP_1451
key_finding: PA14_15840 (= PA3756, LdtPae3) was tentatively assigned to OprI release only because it formed no amide bonds and resembles YafK. Deleting ldtPae3 changed no muropeptide; the Tri-to-KR marker at m/z 1154.567 persists in that deletant and is lost only in ldtPae2, triple and oprI deletants. The protein would not express solubly, so no activity was measured.
confidence_and_limitations: High confidence in what the paper reports. The hydrolase assignment for the ortholog is by exclusion, not by assay.

claim_tested: KT2440 inventory of the two L
context: Gene deletion showed LdtPae1 (PA0732) is the only 3-to-3 cross-linking enzyme and LdtPae2 (PA2854) is the only OprI-anchoring enzyme in P. aeruginosa. Also states that the three LDT functions do not fall into distinct evolutionary lineages.
confidence_and_limitations: P. aeruginosa PA14 and heterospecific expression in E. coli
column8: High. The lineage caveat limits how far subfamily membership alone can assign function.

claim_tested: Identity of the anchoring enzyme and the attachment residue
key_finding: PA2854 is the catalyst that anchors OprI in live P. aeruginosa; reconstituted in vitro with purified PA2854, OprI and synthetic peptidoglycan; attaches the epsilon-amino group of Lys83 of OprI to the stem peptide. X-ray of OprI trimer at 2.1 A and of PA2854 at 2.63 A.
confidence_and_limitations: High, but access was limited to the abstract; the full text is not open access, so only abstract-level statements are used.

claim_tested: PP_1451 has a competent cysteine site
key_finding: STRUCTAL superposition of the AlphaFold model AF-Q88MW7-F1-model_v6 onto 8IKR chain A gave 126 aligned pairs, 1.56 A RMSD over 118 core pairs. C143 maps to C159 (0.97 A), H135 to H137 (1.04 A), A145 to A161 (0.95 A). His NE2 to Cys SG is 4.05 A in the model, 4.32 A in 8IKR and 4.21 A in LdtD/YcbB 6NTW. Mapped residues have pLDDT 90.5 to 98.6.
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high. The geometry is competent but does not discriminate hydrolase from transpeptidase, since YcbB has the same dyad spacing. phenix.superpose_pdbs failed on this pair (12.9% identity, 6.93 A over 12 atoms) and was replaced by a sequence-independent method.

claim_tested: Substrate-contact residues of DpaA in PP_1451
key_finding: Of the six non-catalytic positions tested by Ala scanning in DpaA, K83 is conserved as K82 and R108 as R105, Q86 is conservatively replaced by E85, but Y109 becomes F106, K130 becomes S132 and Y131 becomes M133. The two positions whose mutation cost DpaA the most activity, Y109A at 0.7% and Y131A at 4%, are the two not conserved in PP_1451.
confidence_and_limitations: Medium. Positions are mapped by structure, not by assay, and loss of a hydroxyl does not prove loss of substrate binding, but it does mean specificity cannot be assumed to be identical to DpaA.

claim_tested: KT2440 lacks a YcbB-type 3-to-3 cross-linking enzyme
key_finding: Three methods agree on exactly two PF03734 proteins in KT2440: UniProt Pfam query n=2, InterPro IPR005490 taxon 160488 count 2, and a profile-free MSP scan of all 5527 proteins where the best YcbB hit scored 64 against background 60, 56, 55, 55, 54. PF20142, the YcbB-specific accessory domain, is absent. PP_2320 vs PA0732 scores 64 at 22.8%, background.
context: P. putida KT2440 reference proteome UP000000556
confidence_and_limitations: High for absence of a YcbB-type enzyme. Absence of a cross-linking activity is a weaker claim, since PP_2320 alone was not assignable against E. coli paralogues.

stance: Assignment of PP_2320 and PP_1451 to characterised enzymes
claim_tested: PA14 tags mapped to PAO1: PA14_27180 identical to PA2854, PA14_15840 identical to PA3756, PA14_54810 98.8% to PA0732. Smith-Waterman: PP_2320 vs PA2854 1300 at 76.2% over 319 aa, same PANTHER subfamily PTHR30582:SF24, identical catalytic loop SHGCFRM. PP_1451 vs PA3756 579 at 57.1% over 184 aa, same subfamily PTHR36699:SF1, loops TDGCIAM and TNGCIAM.
context: High. Identity at 57 to 76% to a functionally tested protein is a sound basis for transfer, limited by what was actually demonstrated for PA3756.

claim_tested: MSP scan of 5527 KT2440 proteins against P. aeruginosa OprI returns Q88KG8 at 371 with the next hit at 71. Q88KG8 is oprI / PP_2322, 83 aa, 94.0% identical ungapped with five substitutions, lipobox Cys20 conserved and the attachment residue Lys83 conserved as the C-terminal residue. PP_2322 sits two locus numbers from PP_2320; PP_1451 is unlinked.
context: High. Removes the no-Lpp caveat for this genome. Genomic linkage supports the PP_2320 assignment more directly than the PP_1451 assignment.

stance: Co-occurrence of hydrolase and anchoring transpeptidase
claim_tested: Across 22 gammaproteobacterial reference proteomes, all 18 genomes carrying a DpaA-like gene also carry at least one L,D-transpeptidase. Three carry transpeptidases with no DpaA-like gene (H. influenzae Rd 0+1, A. baumannii 0+2, M. catarrhalis 0+2) and F. tularensis SCHU S4 carries neither. No genome carries a DpaA-like hydrolase without a transpeptidase. KT2440 is the minimal 1+1 pair.
context: Medium-high. Classification used the Cys+2 residue plus PANTHER PTHR36699 membership, not experiment, and 22 genomes is a small sample.
